method: Each bug report was compared by hand with the maintainers' list after the run. "exact": the report describes that planted bug. "partial": it describes part of it, or the list's wording is too short to be sure.
coverage: One run: Chromium on desktop and a Pixel 7 screen, through the app's own pages and the API calls they make. No Firefox or Edge, no pixel comparison, no attack payloads, no email.

matches.note: The list names internal fields such as failed_login_attempts; the report leads with the password hash and also names failed_login_attempts.
The list titles bug 9 only as a Billing Address typo; the report quotes the heading "Blliling Adress".

not_on_list.finding: A Categories menu entry labelled "UNDEFINED" opens an empty category
Every payment method asks for the same bank account fields
Placeholder brand names "Brand name 1" to "Brand name 10"
The home page requests /broken.png, which returns 404. It is probably planted bug 28 or 30, but the report does not say which image, so it is not counted
